subject: a crescent character made from accordion pleats
pose: hopping with one end folded underneath
art_direction: 月牙形角色的身体由折扇褶组成，跃起时一边压缩一边展开，桃粉与靛蓝形成鲜明节奏。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Create a crescent-shaped character built from thick accordion-pleated fabric. One end curls under as a small foot while the other lifts, capturing a buoyant hop. The pleats compress tightly on one side and open wide on the other, making the movement visible in the construction. Use dusty rose fabric outside and indigo within the folds, with one tiny embroidered eye near the upper end. Keep the expression lighthearted and the silhouette clearly crescent-shaped. Place it against a pale butter background with a small detached shadow below. The character occupies about seventy percent of the square and stays within a circular crop, without stars, text, or additional moon imagery.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for distinct original concept, appealing silhouette and expression, requested medium, coherent shape/anatomy, clean visual hierarchy, no text or watermark
